subject: Addendum: E48 lighting keys on D: (Enablers 03 now 803), only E02 007-010 open
body:
Addendum to my last note: E48-lighting-keys (16 frames, from Z_8 and Z_10) has also landed in GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03 as a new folder, with its NOTES.md and SHA256SUMS. Nothing was overwritten.

GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03: 803 images (886 files).
MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: fc2c6aa0e89d3b42a336ccf01500b8f750ec868331d7393bb5df3087db54c0b1 (supersedes ee777661...dc2b)
SHORTLIST.md is unchanged, because E48 has no L/S scores in the qa files.

Correction to the gaps list: E48 is no longer a gap. The only remaining gap is E02 007-010 (Z_7). E02 007 and 008 drafts are on D:, but they are still counted as open.
Everything is preliminary, and nothing is accepted until Nova intake or Ziggy accepts it.
